description: Baseline window permissions for the frameless, custom-drawn titlebar (design/README.md §1): minimize/toggleMaximize/close are IPC commands and, unlike the drag region, are ACL-gated. Scoped to exactly what titlebar.ts calls — allow-maximize/allow-unmaximize are separate commands the frontend never invokes (it only calls toggleMaximize()) and are deliberately omitted. `dialog:allow-open` is scoped the same way for welcome.ts/tabs.ts's file/folder pickers — they only ever call the plugin's `open()`, never the message/ask dialogs. `dialog:allow-save` is exportsheet.ts's destination picker (design §10). `opener:allow-open-url` is viewer.ts's gated external-link bridge — the sandboxed document iframe has no allow-top-navigation/allow-popups of its own, so this is the only way an external link can ever open, and only via an explicit postMessage from a real click.
